tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground for every chapter. ink 16.1:1, ink-muted 5.2:1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating dock, inputs, phone screens, tooltips. One step above surface. ink 17.7:1, ink-muted 5.8:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body on surface and surface-raised, the solid fill of primary buttons, the phone bezel.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, mono labels and captions on surface and surface-raised only. Never on colour fills.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and card outlines. Decorative only (1.3:1): never the only cue for state or a control boundary.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: The only accent: a bright yellow. Fills and highlights only, never text or a thin line on bone (1.2:1). Used for the cursor ball (a plain circle, no border, no shadow), the highlighter behind the one accent word per headline (ink text on it, 13.2:1), the tags around the launch name, progress marks inside scenes, and the full-screen Contact scene. On the Contact scene the cursor turns ink. One yellow accent per viewport, apart from the cursor.

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Ink text and marks on a yellow fill: 13.2:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard focus ring with 3px offset. 16.1:1 on bone, 13.2:1 on yellow; use on-ink on ink scenes.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: A lift on the ink ground: phone bezels and hairlines inside ink scenes. Decorative.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the ink ground in dark scenes (Craft, Contact): 16.1:1.

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy and labels on the ink ground: 7.4:1.
